method: Each normative acceptance scenario is semantically reviewed against the current production owner path and named executable tests. This ledger does not infer correctness from marker presence. A case can be binding-complete while certification remains pending current supported CI.
certification_rule: Set certified=true only after the exact candidate implementation head is green on all supported implementation CI legs, including release-schema verification, design pin, wheel build and packaged authority-resource verification. Any later production/design change reopens affected cases.
known_limits: Production SQLCipher key-provider implementation remains LLD-12-owned; LLD-01 tests use the explicit provider seam and must not be cited as LLD-12 release certification.
LLD-08 Infrastructure has not been started.
The separate mechanical acceptance-marker reporter remains report-only and is not semantic certification.

cases.note: ConnectionFactory is the authoritative DB boundary; required pragmas are verified per connection, check_same_thread remains enabled, unmanaged production connects are statically rejected and nested authoritative UoWs fail closed.
cases.scenario: every authoritative connection path uses ConnectionFactory
prove: foreign_keys=1
required connection pragmas verified
unmanaged/unsafe connection cannot enter repository/UoW
connection does not cross threads

cases.note: Complete release-schema FK analysis is now runtime-enforced. Sequence 13 adds only the three ordinary missing lookup indexes; accepted PK/UNIQUE autoindexes and closed nullable IS NOT NULL partial indexes qualify without redundant full indexes.
cases.scenario: FK-to-index analyser over complete release schema
prove: every child FK has usable leading-prefix index or accepted measured exception
disabled/missing index fails acceptance
explicitly allocated nullable-FK IS NOT NULL partial indexes pass without a redundant full index
lifecycle-filtered, unrelated-column, expression-key and wrong-leading-order indexes do not establish coverage
coverage proof does not depend on current row contents

cases.note: Clean init and supported forward origins are exercised with ledger preservation and failure-safe prefix behavior. Later Foundation migrations remain forward-only and historical accepted rows are not rewritten.
cases.scenario: clean initialization and every supported migration origin
prove: schema+ledger commit together
failure leaves last committed version
clean-init temp database is never published before full verification
retry applies each accepted migration exactly once
accepted 1..4 database advances through Foundation sequence 5 without rewriting prior migration rows or command receipts

accepted exact 1..7 database advances through Foundation sequence 8 without rewriting migrations 1..7 or changing any preexisting durable_jobs/job_attempts value inside the migration transaction except the new nullable dedupe_sha256 column reading NULL
post-migration startup reconciliation finishes before READY and leaves no nonterminal legacy row with dedupe_sha256 NULL claimable

cases.note: Missing/renamed/reordered/CRLF/BOM/content/hash/ledger drift is fail-closed; runtime does not rewrite accepted truth to match unexpected bytes.
prove: missing/renamed/reordered/CRLF/BOM/content/hash/ledger changes block readiness
runtime never rewrites manifest or ledger to match unexpected bytes

cases.note: Offline migration/status reads remain observational: missing targets stay missing, ownership blocks direct inspection and sidecars are classified without opening a writer.
prove: missing target stays missing
no directory/database/WAL/SHM/journal/diagnostic/default is created
current offline target bytes/mtime are unchanged
unsafe offline sidecar state returns limited classification without touching writer

cases.note: Material mutation, receipt, exact response snapshot and all required audits share one outer UoW. Required audit/result/commit failures cannot report success with partial authoritative state.
prove: domain mutation + required lifecycle event + command receipt + exact replay-result snapshot + audit all commit or all rollback
constraint/audit/result-snapshot/disk failure never reports success

prove: plain duplicate audit insert fails
UPDATE fails
DELETE fails
OR IGNORE/REPLACE is absent from audit repository
backup/restore verification preserves audit rows

cases.note: Foundation now owns effective audit ceilings centrally. Exact reviewed exceptions cover Working Note history, LLD-06 500-ref batch classification and LLD-07 2000-ref bulk summary; unlisted actions remain at the ordinary Foundation ceilings.
prove: unknown field/duplicate key/nonfinite/oversized/deep/excessive/sensitive payload rejects
associated mutation rolls back
historical payload version remains readable without rewrite
ordinary audit payload over 16384 UTF-8 bytes or more than 128 audit result refs rejects
only exact listed action-schema-version tuples receive larger allocations; unlisted versions never inherit them
Working Note edit/removal receive 524288 payload bytes; 65536-byte note evidence including worst-case JSON escaping fits with bounded metadata and 65537-byte note evidence rejects without truncation
LLD-06 batch classification receives 32768 payload bytes and at most 500 immutable classification-event audit result refs, sufficient for its accepted 500-target batch without widening other actions
LLD-07 inventory.bulk.accepted receives 262144 payload bytes for its accepted 2000 typed payload refs; its audit_event_results remain under the ordinary 128-ref limit
exceptions do not admit unknown fields, secrets, excess nesting or unauthorized result refs; any audit failure rolls back receipt and owner mutation
AddWorkingNote and EditWorkingNote transport accept valid maximum-size escaped note bodies within their exact route ceiling; unrelated route ceilings remain unchanged

cases.note: Strict/canonical JSON rejects duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, invalid Unicode, unknown/missing fields and bound violations without collapsing missing/null/empty semantics.
prove: duplicate keys/NaN/Infinity/malformed UTF-8/unknown version follow contract
missing/null/empty remain distinguishable
failed upgrade preserves previous document

cases.note: Canonical instance ownership is exclusive across processes, same-process races and hard-link aliases; competing ownership cannot progress into migration/host authority.
cases.scenario: two concurrent launches against same data instance
prove: one holds instance lock
second never migrates or binds competing authoritative host
verified-existing-instance path is used or second exits safely

cases.note: Socket is pre-bound to 127.0.0.1, Windows exclusive-address-use is asserted when available, non-loopback/wildcard/LAN/localhost registry locators are rejected and Uvicorn proxy headers are disabled.
prove: only 127.0.0.1 is bound
SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE is applied on Windows
socket is pre-bound before Uvicorn receives it
wildcard/LAN/proxy-forwarded authority is rejected

cases.note: Registry removal binds exact run_id + data_instance_id, not PID/port presence; authenticated run mismatch is rejected and cleanup removes only current-owned registry state.
prove: file/PID/port alone never establishes identity
registry mismatch never causes unrelated shutdown
registry is removed only for exact current run/data identity

cases.note: Replay returns immutable stored typed results before prepare/owner reads and fails closed on integrity damage. Elevated replay bounds are exact schema/version allocations for RFC branches and the reviewed Inventory 2000-target result.
prove: same command_id + same command_type + same request_hash returns byte-equivalent prior typed result from immutable command_receipt_results
replay path performs no command prepare, owner repository/projection read, mutation, participant call or duplicate audit/event
later changes to target or unrelated state cannot change replay result
same command_id with different command_type or hash fails IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
stored-result schema/hash/canonicalization corruption fails closed rather than falling back to current state

schema/version-specific replay allocations are exact: RfcBranchV1 v1 accepts the reviewed 32 MiB/depth-8/8192 allocation and InventoryMutationResultV1 v1 accepts 512 KiB/depth-8/8192 for the LLD-07 2000-target bulk response; unlisted versions cannot inherit elevated allocations, and replay applies the same exact tuple bounds used at commit

cases.note: BEGIN IMMEDIATE contention maps to retryable PersistenceBusy while WAL readers retain a consistent snapshot; connection/transaction accounting remains verified.
prove: BEGIN IMMEDIATE contention returns retryable busy rather than partial write
readers remain consistent
no write transaction includes artificial wait/operator/file parsing

cases.note: Quiescence closes new writer/executor admission, drains under one decreasing deadline, checkpoints WAL, stops server and releases ownership only after cleanup is proven safe; failed drains/stops retain ownership for retry.
cases.scenario: graceful shutdown under idle and active work
prove: new mutations stop at QUIESCING
active UoWs finish/rollback
WAL checkpoint/connection close/socket close/lock release occur in order
repeated shutdown is safe

cases.note: Data-instance identity is persisted in the database, survives reopen/path-display aliases and restore, remains stable across runtime restart, and a new clean instance receives a distinct identity.
prove: new clean instance gets one stable data_instance_id
restart/path display changes do not change it
restore preserves restored identity
new empty instance never reuses prior identity

cases.note: Starlette/Uvicorn execute directly with one worker and no Node runtime dependency. Supported Python 3.13/3.14 Windows plus 3.14 Ubuntu evidence remains an exact-head CI certification requirement.
prove: Starlette/Uvicorn direct dependency set imports and executes startup/shutdown on both supported Python lines
no installed Node.js is needed at runtime
server uses one worker

cases.note: Accepted semantic NO_CHANGE persists one receipt plus exact immutable response, emits no fabricated domain audit/mutation and replays from stored result; command-id hash conflicts remain integrity failures.
prove: fresh preconditions prove requested state already equals accepted target state
command_receipt commits with result_type=NO_CHANGE plus exact immutable NO_CHANGE response snapshot
no domain row/revision/lifecycle event/audit event is fabricated
lost-response retry with same command_id/type/hash returns the exact stored NO_CHANGE response even if unrelated state later changes
same command_id with different hash still fails integrity

cases.note: Diagnostics expose bounded technical counts/categories and sanitized codes only; reads remain observational and do not materialize durable-job payload/checkpoint bodies.

prove: GetFoundationDiagnosticsState returns only bounded technical counts/categories and sanitized Foundation error codes
query performs no domain or technical mutation and creates no audit/diagnostic side effect merely because it was read

durable-job counts are derived with bounded indexed reads and do not materialize job payload/checkpoint JSON

cases.note: Forward sequence 5 adds exact replay-result storage/guards without rewriting accepted 1..4 migration identities or legacy command receipts.
cases.scenario: forward replay-result migration preserves legacy receipts
prove: accepted/applied migrations 1..4 remain byte/identity/sequence stable
sequence 5 creates only command_receipt_results plus its append-only guards
all legacy command_receipts survive with identical columns/values/count
migration performs no current-domain reads or synthetic result backfill
historical migration-5 allocation repair changed only then-unimplemented future allocations and never rewrote migrations 1..4

cases.note: A matching legacy receipt without an exact stored result returns IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE before prepare, rerun or owner-state reconstruction.
prove: matching legacy receipt without exact result companion returns IDEMPOTENCY_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE
prepare callback is never invoked
owner tables/projections are not read to fabricate the response
no receipt/domain/audit/history row is rewritten or duplicated

cases.note: Durable-job dedupe identity, claim tokens, retry timing, cancellation, legacy-null recovery, prior-run interruption and restore reconciliation are all bound to indexed persisted authority and fail closed on contract/corruption ambiguity.
cases.scenario: durable-job indexed semantic coalescing, exact claims and recovery
prove: sequence 8 adds only durable_jobs.dedupe_sha256 plus idx_jobs_dedupe_state and uq_jobs_active_dedupe while accepted 1..7 remain byte/identity/sequence stable
clean init and exact 1..7 upgrade converge on the same schema; migration itself preserves every legacy durable job/attempt value and gives legacy rows dedupe_sha256 NULL

before READY startup recovery terminalizes every nonterminal legacy-NULL job as failed with LEGACY_JOB_DEDUPE_UNAVAILABLE, never derives a semantic key from historical payload, records one interrupted attempt only for an unrepresented legacy running ordinal, and leaves terminal legacy rows unchanged
after startup recovery no queued/running/waiting_review/retry_wait row with dedupe_sha256 NULL is claimable

new enqueue validates registered payload and exact packet-derived semantic dedupe key before persisting only its bounded lowercase SHA-256 identity; raw dedupe key is not persisted merely for coalescing
same registered active semantic key coalesces to one job and concurrent duplicate active insertion is rejected by uq_jobs_active_dedupe
packet-declared completed-state coalescing is supported through indexed lookup without weakening the active uniqueness rule

dedupe hash collision, persisted payload/key disagreement, duplicate candidate matches, unknown contract/version, malformed/noncanonical/oversized payload or checkpoint fail closed without executing the job
claim ordering is deterministic and retry_wait is not claimable before next_attempt_at_utc
claim/checkpoint/complete/fail bind job_id + run_id + attempt_ordinal + claim_started_at_utc so a stale same-run prior attempt cannot mutate a newer attempt
one terminal/interrupted job_attempts row exists per ended running attempt ordinal and cancellation/recovery cannot duplicate it
stale prior-run recovery records interrupted evidence before applying the exact registered crash policy and is replay/idempotency safe
restore reconciliation invalidates restored nonterminal work before READY and never fabricates domain lifecycle state
